bio: This eatery is a good alternative to the Brockel Schlimbach restaurant at Nideggen's centuries-old castle, Burg Nideggen. They serve market-based cuisine in the form of regional dishes, prepared from fresh seasonal ingredients mainly sourced from suppliers and producers in the region. The interior decor is modern and the front-of-house team is very friendly and obliging. Weather permitting, you can dine on the pretty terrace in the castle courtyard.
